description: This file defines the ReturnReason class, which manages CRUD operations and data retrieval for return reasons within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods to add, edit, delete, and fetch return reason data and descriptions, interfacing with the database and cache systems.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing return reasons, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving return reason data and related descriptions.

methods.name: addReturnReason
methods.description: Adds a new return reason to the database, inserting descriptions for each language, and returns the new return reason ID.

methods.name: editReturnReason
methods.description: Replaces an existing return reason's data and descriptions with new values.

methods.name: deleteReturnReason
methods.description: Deletes a return reason from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getReturnReason
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return reason by ID, including its name in the current language.

methods.name: getReturnReasons
methods.description: Fetches all return reasons filtered by language, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReturnReasons
methods.description: Returns the total count of return reasons in the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific return reason and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return reason.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions of return reasons for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasonsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reason descriptions associated with a particular language ID.
